document.abstract: A densitometer based on the inverse square law was described before this Society at the meeting held at Ottawa in 1923<sup>1</sup> While this instrument has proved eminently satisfactory, it was deemed advisable to construct a densitometer which would be more portable and would be relatively inexpensive.
